item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
I like this idea a lot, even if it's more of an exposition piece on MCD than an idea that's interesting in its own right. The insanity seems a bit gratuitous, but not nearly as much as the requirement for surgically-deafened personnel. Just use earmuffs or earplugs, and everyone gets to go home with their Corti organs intact. Overall, it seems rather well thought-out. The grammar and spelling mistakes, however, detract from its tone. Please correct these.

Most notable is the focus on observation over explanation. It contributes tremendously to the scientific feel of an article. If this gets deleted, and it looks like it might, please give it an edit and resubmit it.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: It seems like a really good concept, but it would be more interesting if the gibberings meant something. In general, it looks like it needs a working over, with an eye towards spelling and grammar. The use of "it's" to mean something of it is very grating to me.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: The concept is pretty decent, and the MC&D reference is a plus. However, it is also two of the SCP Cliches: Things what make you go nuts for no apparent reason, and Things what use up excessive resources (which I assume "deaf guards" counts as). Remove the insanity-making, and this could be really good, but downvote for now. Also, Euclid?
